description: This file defines a mock class `MockIInterfaceDetailsIterator`, which implements the `INetworkManager::IInterfaceDetailsIterator` interface. It uses Google Mock to facilitate unit testing of network interface iteration, providing mock implementations for methods such as `Next`, `Previous`, `Reset`, `IsValid`, `Count`, `Current`, `AddRef`, `Release`, and `QueryInterface`. The file is intended for testing purposes within the network manager module of the project.

classes.name: MockIInterfaceDetailsIterator
classes.description: A mock class for `IInterfaceDetailsIterator` interface used in unit testing to simulate network interface details iteration.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Mocks the method to move to the next network interface detail.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Mocks the method to move to the previous network interface detail.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Mocks the method to reset the iterator to a specific position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Mocks the method to check if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Mocks the method to get the total count of interface details.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Mocks the method to get the current interface detail.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Mocks the method to increment reference count.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Mocks the method to decrement reference count.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Mocks the method to query for other interfaces.
